membership_method: S&P/ASX 200 membership on each event date was rebuilt backwards from the anchor list (taken as the membership in force on 2021-09-19) by undoing every S&P/ASX 200 addition/removal parsed from S&P DJI index announcements released on the ASX under code ZSP between Dec 2009 and Sep 2021, then the 20 Sep 2021 review was applied forward. Only events of companies that were members on the event date are included; delisted and since-removed members are included.

gaps.reason: Company-website copies of 2010-2021 documents were not verified, so every row links the ASX announcement copy (doc_source=exchange). No company URLs were constructed.

AGM rows are dated by the meeting-day release (results of meeting / chair or CEO address). A bare 'Results of Meeting' or chair address is counted as the AGM only within 100 days after a 'Notice of Annual General Meeting'; AGMs announced only by notice, with no meeting-day release found in headlines, are not included.

Event types are assigned from ASX announcement headlines (the listing has no document-type field for 2010-2021); documents with non-standard headlines can be missed. 'period' is set only where the headline states it (e.g. FY15, 1H15, Q3 FY15).
Investor/strategy days are captured only when the headline names the event; trading updates and guidance releases were not collected.
